Only policy.md and inputs.json in the sol-before arm were read. Exact repository paths, current source contents, plan inventories, dirty paths, branches, commands beyond supplied facts, and expected answers were unavailable and are marked unknown or conditional.

Profitability scores use only the supplied recurrence and risk facts; a real audit must verify current authority, exact maintenance cost, repository state, and deterministic validation before implementation.

The adoption packets describe the authorized next actions and gates. Their blocked or review-only status reflects unexecuted synthetic evidence and, where applicable, unapproved required reconciliation; they do not claim an adoption occurred.
